verified_requirements: Unknown final tool return is manual failure regardless of interruption phase
Possible judge MATCH preserved; never rewritten or rerun to force STOP
No wait reentry without observed rc15
Existing-watch rc20 is procedural deviation, never recovery
Only observed tool return/errors recorded, no invented return or timestamps
Last wait return0 is a manual-only additional success condition
rc16 competing or still-active watcher can leave a later normal chain
Start-window check is not a physical fsync/link/Popen completion bound
Prior source bytes and commands retained; user choice, v3 review, and runtime approval separated

nonblocking_advisories.topic: Qualify rc19 STOP reasoning by single-watcher/no-reentry assumptions and surviving record defects
nonblocking_advisories.text: 반환19는 항상 수동 실패 종결이다. 단일 감시·실패 후 재진입 금지 전제에서, 판정 시 필요한 기록 부재·사슬 미완·임시파일 잔존이 확인되면 판정기는 STOP이다. 반환19 자체가 판정기 입력인 것은 아니며, MATCH가 나와도 원출력 보존과 수동 실패는 유지한다.
nonblocking_advisories.classification_basis: Single-watcher paths already fail the judge on missing chain/watch or temporary files. A MATCH counterpath needs an additional prohibited watcher plus a separate recoverable file-creation error; not a new normal-path blocker. Manual failure already prevents normal progression.
